content:
maria: @here planning a 2-day SI shadow retreat for new Systems Integrator partners next month — goal is hands-on hw + joint marketplace packaging + certification prep. Thinking Wed/Thu. Who can lead labs and hardware handoffs? :wave:

ryan: Love this. Can we fold in cloud marketplace listing checklist? need to align SKU, billing, co-marketing.

annie: I can run the certification primer and the eval station. We'll need candidate qbank and 2 proctors.

jake: On hardware — we should do a pre-shipment checklist. I'll share a quick sample:
```
HW checklist v1:
- 1x GPU node (test image preloaded)
- network VLAN docs
- serial console access creds
- test prompts + perf harness
- packing + returns label
```

maria: perfect, thanks Jake. Ryan — want to own the marketplace session? can you prep a one-pager we can share with SIs before the retreat? @ryan

ryan: yep, will do — I'll add SKU mapping + promo copy. ETA Friday.

annie: Heads-up — dosing the cohort: 8 SIs max, 2 lab tracks (infra / app). We should do a small prework survey. I'll draft.

jake: logistics note — who has budget for shipping customs? some EMEA partners need DDP.

maria: good call. @finance to confirm. Also, let's add a joint-announcement opt-in checkbox so we can coordinate PR with partners.

onboard-bot: Reminder: add new SI -> onboarding cohort at /onboard/create with tags [marketplace, hardware]

ryan: Quick ask — can we rehearse the "fallback routing" demo? need a short script that shows model fallback between hosted -> dedicated -> private.

annie: I'll script a 10-min demo and one failover test. will post prompts + eval thresholds.

maria: next steps:
- Jake: finalize hw checklist + shipping plan (due Tue)
- Ryan: marketplace one-pager + demo script (due Fri)
- Annie: prework survey + cert primer slides (due Wed)
- Maria: schedule venue + PR opt-in form

maria: any blockers? :question:

jake: none from me, just need contact for customs.

ryan: all good.

annie: no blockers. I'll tag the cert content repo later.

maria: awesome — putting this in calendar now. Thanks team :rocket:
